state.$description: Figma STRING variable 'nav/state' (renamed 2026-07-23 from 'color/nav-state') — the designers' one-switch Header nav mechanism: every page's Header nav binds its variant property to this variable ('Transparent' | 'Solid'). Previously projected to the color #00000000 because the pipeline had no string channel; that projection would have CRASHED the first sync (writing COLOR into a STRING variable). The pipeline now carries strings natively.

line-height.$description: Authored from the Button canvas geometry (dump v1.5: text lineHeight 22px). NOT a Figma variable — Piqueray binds no line-height variable; minted from-dump so anatomy can reference a token instead of a literal (the schema forbids literals in anatomy tokens).

space.$description: Authored from the Button canvas geometry (dump v1.5: itemSpacing 10, padding 16/32, Link padding 4/0). NOT Figma variables — Piqueray binds no spacing variables; minted from-dump so anatomy references tokens, not literals.

icon-only.$description: Observed from the governed Figma Button Style=Icône seule master (52×52).

radius.$description: Authored from the Button canvas geometry (dump v1.5: Link cornerRadius 32). NOT a Figma variable; minted from-dump.

border-width.$description: Authored from the Button canvas geometry (dump v1.5: outline strokeWeight 2; non-outline variants have no stroke = 0). NOT Figma variables; minted from-dump. The 0 is the base border so border-style resolves solid and the outline variants' 2px border renders.
